correctness.rationale: Lucas factorization follows directly from the binomial-square identity, including exact endpoint handling because D_1 and D_(p-1) are nonzero for p>=5. The carry recurrence I_L=c*a^(L-1)+I_(L-1) is exhaustive and disjoint. Inclusion-exclusion and the odd-degree finite-field reflection prove the entire statement. Verifier independently checked 19 complete blocks and midpoint congruences through 199; finite checks only corroborate the complete proof.

value.rationale: The exact joint gcd statistic for all prime-power block lengths is a natural invariant of a classical combinatorial sequence. The result identifies infinitely many primes dividing neighboring coefficients on density-one sets, and hence proves neighboring gcds grow beyond any fixed bound in natural density. This is not an arbitrary finite slice or tabular recomputation.
